stemMarkdown: Pipe A can fill a tank in 10 hours and pipe B can fill it in 30 hours. If both are opened together, how many hours will it take to fill the tank? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In one hour A fills $\dfrac{1}{10}$ of the tank and B fills $\dfrac{1}{30}$, so together they fill $\dfrac{1}{10} + \dfrac{1}{30} = 0.133333$ per hour. The full tank takes $\dfrac{1}{0.133333} = 7.5$ hours.
altSolutionMarkdown: Add rates, never times — the combined time is always less than either pipe alone.
